total_fee_share.meaning: totalFeeShare value at the time _decreaseFeeShares is executed

token_unlocked.meaning: whether the token is unlocked (bonding curve finished and pair created by launchpad)

rewards_ended_when_due.meaning: rewards are ended at the point where the token is unlocked and all bonding curve buyers have transferred their tokens
rewards_ended_when_due.checkpoint: after bonding curve completion and buyer transfers

assumptions: The end-rewards path is reachable via _decreaseFeeShares -> _endRewards -> Launchpad.endRewards -> Distributor.endRewards.
The report's 'should' condition is the token being unlocked and all bonding curve buyers having transferred their tokens.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish that the token-unlocked-and-all-buyers-transferred state was actually reached in a transaction; the impact is stated as potential.

limitations: Formalizes only the cannot_end_rewards_when_it_should impact; the separate sole-buyer sell failure impact is not covered here.
The potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the unlocked-and-transferred state as a scenario condition rather than an observed fact.
